title: Answers-led pricing credit for attestation-heavy contracts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large enterprise deals frequently stall or demand manual discounting because customers require extensive security questionnaire completion (SIG/CAIQ) and bespoke evidence packs. Sales and legal currently absorb high time costs to respond, which increases CAC and slows time-to-revenue.

Goal: Run a two-month experiment that offers a standardized, answers-led pricing credit for deals that meet a minimum evidence threshold (e.g., completed SIG/CAIQ + required artifact upload). The credit is intended to: accelerate contract velocity, reduce manual engineering/legal hours per deal, and surface whether financial concessions tied to clear checklist completion improves conversion more than ad-hoc discounts.

Hypothesis: If we offer a visible, automatable pricing credit (one-time onboarding credit or first-quarter rebate) conditional on customers completing a curated answers checklist + artifact submission, then sales conversion for attestation-heavy prospects will improve by at least 10% and average legal review time per deal will drop by 30%.

Scope: Apply to midmarket and enterprise deals in NA/EMEA that request SIG/CAIQ or equivalent security questionnaires. The experiment will: 1) define the minimal checklist, 2) implement a lightweight productized credit flow (billing/quotes), 3) add a checklist UI and upload hook in the sales portal, 4) capture metrics and feedback for 8 weeks.

Out of scope: Full automation of evidence collection, customized attestation packaging, changes to SLAs or contract language outside the credit mechanics.
acceptance_criteria: Productized billing credit is implemented and visible to sales as an option in the quotes UI
Checklist definition (SIG/CAIQ minimal answers + artifact list) is approved by Security and Legal
At least 10 pilot deals run through the flow with tracked timestamps for start -> signed
Metrics dashboard shows conversion uplift or no-regression and legal review time reduction compared to baseline
Customer feedback template collected for each pilot and included in post-mortem
steps: Define minimal answers checklist with Security (consolidate top 20 fields customers ask for)
Design lightweight upload + attest checkbox in sales portal (PM/Design/Growth)
Implement billing credit voucher flow and reporting in Stripe/Quotes (Finance/Payments)
Build dashboard in Looker with baseline from last 6 months and experiment cohort filter
Run pilot with 3 SDR-led deals and 7 AE-led deals; collect timestamps and feedback
Post-mortem and decision: scale, iterate, or retire after 8 weeks

decisions: Use a one-time billing credit (applied within first invoice quarter) rather than discounting list price to avoid long-term revenue recognition complications
Checklist will be minimally prescriptive: completion required + upload of at least two artifacts, one proving encryption/backups and one proving access control
Pilot limited to NA/EMEA to reduce localization and tax complexity
Security review will sign-off checklist but not individual evidence for the pilot; manual review reserved for flagged risk cases
